title: Average doesn't get an average share
hook: Being average used to be safe. Now it's the most expensive place to stand.

scenes.say: Being average used to be safe. Now it's the most expensive place to stand.
Income, views, sales: they don't split evenly. They follow a power law.
Simulate {n} people on a power law.
The top fifth takes about {top20} of everything.
When rewards pile up at the top, a small edge in skill becomes a huge edge in outcome.
You don't need to be the best at everything. You need to be hard to replace at one thing.

takeaway: You don't need to be the best at everything. You need to be hard to replace at one thing.
